"""Run every batch of data/ through process.py, waiting out the rate limit between calls."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

for i in range(1, 13):
    path = "data/batch_{:02d}.csv".format(i)
    while True:
        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "process.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(res.stdout.strip(), flush=True)
        if res.returncode == 0:
            break
        if res.returncode == 75:
            m = re.search(r"retry in (\d+)", res.stdout)
            time.sleep(int(m.group(1)) if m else 30)
            continue
        print("FAILED {} rc={} {}".format(path, res.returncode, res.stderr), flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
print("ALL_DONE", flush=True)

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the rate limit window when refused.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
    if [ $rc -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      sleep "${w:-30}"
    else
      echo "batch_$i failed rc=$rc"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL DONE

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the validation rate limit.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
    if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      sleep $(( ${w:-10} + 1 ))
    else
      echo "FAILED rc=$rc on batch_$i"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo "ALL DONE"

import re
import subprocess

import time

for i in range(1, 13):

    while True:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "process.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = p.stdout.strip()
        print(out, flush=True)
        if p.returncode == 0:
            break
        if p.returncode == 75:
            m = re.search(r"retry in (\d+) s", out)
            time.sleep(int(m.group(1)) if m else 10)
            continue
        print("FAILED rc={} {}".format(p.returncode, p.stderr), flush=True)

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the validation rate limit when refused.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in $(seq -w 1 12); do
  f="data/batch_$i.csv"
  while true; do
    out="$(python3 process.py "$f")"
    rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      break
    elif [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
      w="$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')"
      sleep "${w:-30}"
    else
      echo "FAILED $f rc=$rc"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL_DONE

"""Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the validation rate limit on refusal."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

for i in range(1, 13):
    path = "data/batch_{:02d}.csv".format(i)
    while True:
        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "process.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = (res.stdout + res.stderr).strip()
        print(out, flush=True)
        if res.returncode == 0:
            break
        if res.returncode == 75:
            m = re.search(r"retry in (\d+)", out)
            time.sleep(int(m.group(1)) if m else 30)
            continue
        print("{} failed with exit code {}".format(path, res.returncode), flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
print("ALL_DONE", flush=True)

"""Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the rate limit when refused."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

for i in range(1, 13):
    path = "data/batch_{:02d}.csv".format(i)
    while True:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "process.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = (p.stdout + p.stderr).strip()
        print(out, flush=True)
        if p.returncode == 0:
            break
        if p.returncode == 75:
            m = re.search(r"retry in (\d+)", out)
            time.sleep(int(m.group(1)) if m else 10)
            continue
        print("FAILED rc={} on {}".format(p.returncode, path), flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
print("ALL_DONE", flush=True)

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the rate limit when refused.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
    if [ $rc -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      sleep "${w:-10}"
    else
      echo "FAILED rc=$rc on batch_$i"; exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL_DONE

"""Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the rate limit instead of hammering it."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

for i in range(1, 13):
    path = "data/batch_{:02d}.csv".format(i)
    while True:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "process.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(p.stdout.strip() or p.stderr.strip(), flush=True)
        if p.returncode == 75:
            m = re.search(r"retry in (\d+)", p.stdout)
            time.sleep(int(m.group(1)) if m else 30)
            continue
        if p.returncode != 0:
            print("FAILED {} rc={}".format(path, p.returncode), flush=True)
        break

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the validation rate limit when refused.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ s$' | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
      sleep $((w + 1))
      continue
    fi
    [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && echo "batch_$i failed rc=$rc"
    break
  done
done
echo DONE

"""Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the rate limit window when refused."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

for i in range(1, 13):
    path = "data/batch_{:02d}.csv".format(i)
    while True:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "process.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(p.stdout.strip(), p.stderr.strip(), flush=True)
        if p.returncode == 0:
            break
        if p.returncode == 75:
            m = re.search(r"retry in (\d+)", p.stdout)
            time.sleep(int(m.group(1)) + 1 if m else 30)
            continue
        print("FAILED {} rc={}".format(path, p.returncode), flush=True)
        break
print("ALL DONE", flush=True)

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch in order; on a rate-limit refusal (exit 75) wait the advertised time and retry.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break
    if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      sleep $((w + 1))
    else
      echo "FAILED batch_$i rc=$rc"; exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL_DONE

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py in order, waiting out the rate limit on a refusal.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv")
    rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
    if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      sleep $((w + 1))
    else
      echo "FAILED batch_$i rc=$rc"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL_DONE

import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

for i in range(1, 13):

        if p.returncode == 0:

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the validation service's rate limit.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then break; fi
    if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ s$' | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
      sleep "${w:-30}"
    else
      echo "FAILED batch_$i rc=$rc"; exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL_DONE

#!/bin/bash
# Run every batch through process.py, waiting out the rate limit when refused.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  while true; do
    out=$(python3 process.py "data/batch_$i.csv"); rc=$?
    echo "$out"
    [ $rc -eq 0 ] && break
    if [ $rc -eq 75 ]; then
      w=$(echo "$out" | grep -o 'retry in [0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      sleep "${w:-10}"
    else
      echo "FAILED rc=$rc on batch_$i"; exit 1
    fi
  done
done
echo ALL_DONE

## 0.4.0 (unreleased)
- Clock injection for tests.

- First version: a plain read-through cache with a fixed time to live.
- Benchmarks: 40-60% fewer store reads on the sample workload (weeks 18-19).
